protocol.map_class: linear orthonormal R (d_model x 8) = QR(W)[:, :k], nested ranks k in {1, 2, 4, 8}, one rank sampled per step; interchange h <- h + R (R^T h_src - R^T h_base). Declared before any fit (Sutter et al.).
protocol.objective: KL(q_src || q_edit) over the class bins {classes..., other} at the decision position d (bounded, CDAS-style). Label controls: target = class-mean q of the permuted class. Random-init network: target = the TRAINED model's q_src.
protocol.readout: Delta = margin_edit - margin_base, margin = log P(class_src) - log P(class_base) at d, computed on the same path (KV path at the decision site; recompute path at the band).
protocol.recovery: mean(Delta_DAS) / mean(Delta_FULL) over held-out pairs with |Delta_FULL| >= 1 nat; 95% CI from 2,000 two-way cluster bootstrap resamples (source prompts x base prompts); OFF-MANIFOLD flag if recovery > 1.5

sites.dec: block L* = argmax rank-1 2-fold leave-family-out CV recovery over blocks 0,2,4,..; edit of the block-L* OUTPUT at d with the canonical opening prefilled
sites.band: Qwen T10 blocks 12-23 x every spec position, one shared R

fit.batch: decision site 4 bases x 12 sources (48 pairs); band 8 pairs
fit.early_stopping: inner-validation KL (mean over ranks) every 20 steps on one rotated-out train family; patience 3; best state kept
fit.init: W ~ N(0, 1) with torch seed 1000 + fit seed

protocol.k_star: smallest rank whose held-out TF recovery (seed 0) >= 0.9 x the best rank

controls.c1: 50 Haar subspaces per rank (seeds 7000+i): median recovery <= 0.05
controls.c2: label-control refits (seeds 10, 11, 12; same steps/early stopping): cyclic derangements pi1, pi2 and a prompt-level balanced derangement; pairs whose permuted target equals class_base dropped; PRIMARY: held-out recovery toward the TRUE class <= 0.1 x true-fit recovery
controls.c3: randomly initialised network (same config, torch seed 0, HF _init_weights), same map class, objective (trained q_src targets), readout, pairs and steps: mean held-out Delta (random-init / trained) <= 0.25
controls.c4: reverse interchange (base = held-out forced source, source = its padding twin): DAS / full-state reverse >= 0.5
controls.c5: projected-map retention on the top 64 natural twin PCs at (L*, d) >= 0.5; c5b with twins + forced + placement prompts (sensitivity, never substituted)
controls.c6: natural-variance share tr(R^T S R)/tr(S) above the 95th percentile of 1,000 random rank-k subspaces; c6b on the c5b basis
controls.c7: principal angles among the 3 seeds at k*: median first principal cosine >= 0.5 and above the random 99th percentile

verdicts.V0: held-out TF recovery at k* >= 0.5 (CI lower bound > 0.25) AND generation recovery >= 0.5 with pass ratio >= 0.8 AND McNemar DAS > RAND at p < 0.05
verdicts.SUFFICIENT HANDLE: V0 and c1 pass but some of c2-c7 fail (named)
verdicts.K2: confirmed iff T10-dec and GRID-dec are both CERTIFIED; disconfirmed iff a decision site fails c2 or c3 in either family; p_K2 = max over {T10-dec, GRID-dec} of max(p_c2, p_c3) (intersection-union)
verdicts.committed_prediction: both decision sites certified; T10 band passes V0 but fails c4, c5 and the clamp

generation.decoding: T 1.0, top-p 1, no top-k; CRN: one uniform stream per (unit, site, slot) shared by every arm; fence stop
generation.primary_class_extra_ranks: the two ranks of {1, 2, 4} other than k*, 30 each
generation.decision_cells: prompt + canonical opening prefilled; edit at d at L* in the prefill
generation.band_cells: edit at the band's spec positions in the prefill; free generation from index 0

mediation.predictor: pi_u = max_c <z_u, g_c> / ||g_c||^2 (band subspace at k*)
mediation.clamp: 10 most-escaping directions, PUSH / PUSH+TASK-CLAMP / PUSH+RAND-CLAMP (N = 30), PUSH+DEC-CLAMP (N = 10); pass: TASK removal >= 0.5 and RAND <= 0.10

drop_order: third seed at the task site
declared_departures_at_commit0: Hardware: one NVIDIA L4 (23 GB, 300 GB/s), 6 CPUs, 57 GB RAM instead of the planned RTX A4500; ~5.5 h total.
B3 (Kruskal/Prim/Boruvka) is dropped at commit #0 (replication unit; not in the never-dropped list); the Gemma task band is dropped (drop order item 1).
T10 forced sources use 4 display-name paraphrases per template (k x j = 20 per class) so held-out pairs span 8 source prompts per class; (k, j=0) reproduces iteration 7's forced prompts exactly.

Labeller disagreements are not sent to the blind judge (OpenRouter is reserved for the novelty audit): T10 keeps the runtime label flagged 'runtime_unjudged'; GRID marks them 'disputed' (iteration-7 rule).
T10 max_new_tokens 512 after the opening (iteration-7 T10 programs: median 132, max 384).
